coaching.headline: Dominant 23-14 on majors and 72,594-to-0 objective damage won it despite two solo deaths costing a tower pair and inhibitor.
coaching.team: Drongo held the duo lane favored all game against Sparrow, while mid, offlane, support and jungle all read unfavored or split against Howitzer, Greystone, Dekker and Countess. We still won the majors count 23-14, the tower count 7-6, and ran up 72,594 objective damage to the enemy's zero — every enemy player finished with zero damage to a structure. The only sour stretch was a pair of solo catches at 22.9 and 25.2, which gave up an Outer Tower pair, an Inner Tower and an Inhibitor inside three minutes. Everywhere else we converted: three fights won, three cashed into Genesis Core, their Inner Tower pair and their Inhibitor, against the one fight we lost at 16.5 near our Outer Tower, which fell in the same window. The 32.2 full-squad ace took their Inhibitor and opened the door to the Core that closed the game at 34 minutes.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Two solo catches cost four structures in three minutes — an Outer Tower pair, an Inner Tower and an Inhibitor. The squad answered with the 32.2 ace, catching all five of them and opening the Core.
coaching.whatWorked: We won three fights and converted every one into Genesis Core, their Inner Tower pair, or their Inhibitor; they converted zero of their one win beyond that single tower.

loadout.name: Shred Spree
loadout.text: Shrapnel Cannon's Cooldown is reduced by 80%, but it deals 50% less damage.

ability.name: Shrapnel Cannon
ability.what: Unleash a bazooka blast, dealing 170/280/390 (+115%) physical damage to all Enemies hit and Shredding their Physical Armor by 30% for 4s.

loadout.plain: Shrapnel Cannon comes back far more often but hits much softer. It becomes a frequent armor-shred and escape tool rather than a big burst of damage.

loadout.name: Xyris
loadout.text: Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.
loadout.plain: Bonus damage that grows as you kill units through the game. Plain scaling for a farming carry, nothing tied to the kit.

loadout.name: Furor
loadout.text: Entering Hero Combat grants 20% Total Attack Speed for 4s.
loadout.plain: A burst of attack speed when you enter hero combat. Stacks with Rad Rounds for a fast opening flurry.

loadout.name: Eviscerate
loadout.text: Deal +15% bonus damage to targets above 80% Health.
loadout.plain: Extra damage against healthy targets. Helps your opening Gag Grenade and Old Rusty poke land harder at the start of a fight.

loadout.name: Pacifier
loadout.text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.
loadout.plain: A short dash that empowers your next hit, much stronger on low targets, and resets on a kill. Use it to reposition and finish a target your bleed has worn down.
